notes: Sourced directly from Yamaha's official MTX3 Owner's Manual (data.yamaha.com PDF) and corroborated by usa.yamaha.com/products/proaudio/processors/mtx/specs.html. All 8 analog inputs and 8 analog outputs use 3-pin, 5.08mm-pitch Euroblock (detachable screw-terminal) connectors, not XLR — confirmed in the manual's "Euroblock plug connection" section and the Input/Output Characteristics table. Stereo inputs (ST IN 1/2) are unbalanced RCA pairs. YDIF IN/OUT, DCP, and NETWORK all use RJ45 jacks but serve different, non-interchangeable purposes (proprietary digital-audio bus, proprietary control daisy-chain, and standard 100Base-TX Ethernet respectively) — only NETWORK is graded eth-100m since YDIF and DCP are not standard Ethernet data links per Yamaha's own connector-compatibility warning ("connectors that are shaped identically but have a completely different function"). GPI is a 16-pin Euroblock (not a simple binary connector) carrying 7 analog/digital inputs, one 24V-capable input, 4 open-collector outputs, +5V and ground — modeled here as a single bidirectional euroblock port since the port schema has no multi-pin GPI primitive. AC inlet is a standard IEC (C13/C14-style) inlet per the rear-panel diagram and included 2.5m power cord. No USB, HDMI, video, or Dante ports exist on this base MTX3 model (Dante variant is the separate MTX5-D, not covered here). Rack width/depth: 480 x 44 x 351mm (1U), weight 4.8kg.

ports.name: INPUT 1
ports.note: Mic/Line, balanced, 3-pin 5.08mm Euroblock, +48V phantom (individually switchable), gain +66dB/-6dB

ports.name: ST IN 1 (L/R)
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo line input, RCA pin jacks (L and R)

ports.name: ST IN 2 (L/R)
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo line input, RCA pin jacks (L and R)

ports.name: OUTPUT 1
ports.note: Balanced line output, 3-pin 5.08mm Euroblock, 75ohm source impedance

ports.name: YDIF IN
ports.note: Proprietary Yamaha YDIF digital audio transmission format, 16 channels + word clock, CAT5e/STP cable, up to 30m; not a standard Ethernet data link so no eth-x grade applies

ports.name: YDIF OUT
ports.note: Proprietary Yamaha YDIF digital audio transmission format, 16 channels + word clock, CAT5e/STP cable, up to 30m

ports.name: DCP
ports.note: Proprietary daisy-chain connector for Yamaha DCP-series wall control panels; CAT5e/STP straight cable, all 8 pins, up to 200m total; not standard Ethernet networking

ports.name: RS-232C
ports.note: 9-pin D-sub (male), for AMX/Crestron compatible controllers, 38.4/115.2 kbps

ports.name: GPI
ports.note: 16-pin Euroblock: 7 analog/digital inputs (IN 1-7, 0-5V), 1 input supporting +24V (IN 8), 4 open-collector outputs (OUT 1-4), plus +5VDC and ground pins

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: IEC inlet, included detachable power cord (2.5m), 100-240V 50/60Hz, 50W max
